# Real ASP 26.3 fixtures

Generated by an actual locally built AdvancedSlimePaper server from official source commit `3ab54bd48c7ecd28335d88e193b9c87af9275c49` (`dev/26.3`, source version `26.3.build.191-stable`). No custom Java integration plugin was used: the official ASP utility plugin and console commands created and saved the worlds.

- `asp-world-v1.slime`: diamond block at `(0,64,0)` and a chest at `(1,64,0)` containing 7 diamonds.
- `asp-world-v2.slime`: the diamond block is changed to an emerald block.
- `roundtrip-result.json`: exact revision IDs, hashes and eight checks from the successful live-server round trip.
- `build-provenance.json`: source/build identity and JAR hashes.

The live test uploaded both files to SlimeVault with leases and SRF validation enabled, retrieved v1 by version ID, reopened it in ASP, verified the block and chest NBT, loaded a separate cloned world, and verified contents after an ASP server restart.

These are locally generated test worlds. They are not downloaded production worlds, and the locally compiled server is not an independently verified official CI binary. The server ran on loopback with online authentication disabled; player login, external authentication services and sustained player load were not tested.
